visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female presenter with long dark hair, wearing a yellow knit short-sleeved top and grey pants, stands in an indoor studio environment. She holds a bronze-colored smartphone and gestures towards the camera. The background is simple with a poster and a small plant. (2) Close-up shot of hands holding a small, boxed unicorn toy on a wooden surface. The camera then switches to a first-person view of a smartphone screen, which is being used to take a photo of the toy and use a 'Visual Intelligence' feature to identify it. (3) The presenter holds the phone over a McDonald's paper receipt and a photo of a menu. The phone screen displays a real-time translation overlay, converting the text on the receipt into Traditional Chinese. (4) Screen recording sequence showing an Instagram story interface with images of Philippine banknotes. A pop-up menu appears on the phone screen where the user types a query about the currency value, and an AI-generated answer appears in a bottom sheet. (5) Extreme close-up of the side of the bronze smartphone, showing a finger pressing the dedicated camera control button. The phone's screen then activates a viewfinder aimed at succulent plants, displaying a search overlay identifying the plants. (6) Screen recording of the iOS settings menu. The user navigates to the 'Action Button' settings and scrolls through options until selecting 'Visual Intelligence'. (7) The presenter returns to a medium close-up shot, holding the phone and speaking directly to the camera with expressive facial movements. Large colorful text overlays appear around her as she concludes the demonstration.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy female voice speaking in Traditional Chinese over a steady, upbeat electronic BGM track featuring rhythmic synth pulses. The speaker's tone is friendly and fast-paced, typical of social media reviews. (2) A sharp digital 'shutter' sound effect triggers a transition as the speaker describes identifying a toy. The BGM remains constant while short 'pop' and 'ding' sound effects punctuate the identification of the object on screen. (3) The speaker transitions to discussing translation features; her vocal pitch remains high and energetic. A soft UI 'click' is audible as the phone processes the image of the receipt. (4) During the currency conversion section, the vocal continues without pause, and the background music swells slightly in a melodic bridge. A 'bubble' sound effect accompanies the AI's response text appearing in the audio mix. (5) A distinct mechanical-like 'click' SFX is used to highlight the physical button press on the iPhone. The vocal density increases as the speaker explains the setup process, synchronized with the rhythmic beat of the BGM. (6) The final phase features a bright 'stinger' sound effect and a rising vocal inflection as the presenter delivers a closing slogan, with the BGM fading out precisely as the speech ends.
